correctness.rationale: Verified source Definition 2.2 and Remark 2.1 exactly: Parseval K-frame means Σ_j|<x,f_j>|²=||K*x||² so S=KK*. In C², K=diag(1,0), F={e1} has equality for all x; S has spectrum {1,0}, energies Σ||f_j||²=1, while 2||K*e1||²=2 and 2||K*e2||²=0, contradicting both printed claims. Spectral trace gives Σ_j||f_j||²=tr(KK*)=Σ_k||K*e_k||² for every ON eigenbasis; simultaneous equality to n times each eigenvalue iff all eigenvalues coincide (KK*=cI). Strict positivity iff K* injective. Exact finite operator computation, no probabilistic or formal-checker assumptions.
